entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material
available on record.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by applicants to quash the entire criminal proceeding of Case No. 2001 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No. 215 of 2022 including charge sheet and summoning order dated 29.9.2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Rath, District Hamirpur, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate Rath, District Hamirpur.

Santosh Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19369349/
1 3.

entities.text: Santosh Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: During arguments, learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that he does not want to press the prayer for quashing of the above mentioned case.

His sole prayer is that a direction may be issued to the court below to decide the bail application of the applicant in view of the judgment in the case Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC 922.
4.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the present application is disposed of with the direction that in case the applicants filed bail application before the court below, the same shall be heard and disposed of expeditiously by the court below in view of the settled law laid by this Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (Supra).
5.
With the above observations, this application u/s 482 is disposed of finally.
